elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] Still mashing Control Alt Delete every time an app freezes?

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on End Task in Settings.

[friendly] Open System, then For developers. Flip on End Task. Right-click the frozen app, then End task.

[delighted] One right-click, and the frozen app is gone.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
